page: Hetzner Cloud cx53 is an x86_64 virtual machine running on the QEMU hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 shared vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz. The system includes 31.0 GB of system memory, which equates to approximately 1.95 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance features a bundled 320 GB NVMe SSD. No dedicated GPU hardware is included, and the server comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU tests placing in the top 25% at 2667.99. Multi-core performance is average, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 42844.81 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 10997.0. Memory bandwidth is consistent across block sizes, yielding 128.82 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 70.57 GB/sec for large uncached writes. For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates strong text generation performance on small LLM models at 276.25 tokens/sec, while medium model text generation averages 24.29 tokens/sec.

Given its shared CPU allocation, the cx53 offers a cost-efficient profile for multi-core workloads that do not require dedicated CPU threads. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions it as a compute-leaning resource, though the shared CPU model introduces potential performance variability under sustained peak loads. This server is suited for tasks such as software compilation, static web serving, database operations, and moderate-scale text processing.
